description: Backup file format (spec 20). key = HKDF-SHA-256(salt = file salt, ikm = account entropy, info = 'swell backup v1', 32). Chunk i: nonce = 00000000 | u64 i; ad = header ("SWBK" | 01 | salt) | u64 i | u8 last. file = header | chunks, chunk = u8 last | u32 length | AES-256-GCM ciphertext | tag. plaintext is the item stream (1 account, 2 setting, 3 record, 4 file, 5 end); a chunk holds at most 1 MiB of plaintext and only the final chunk has last = 1. The record shown is a stand-in: record contents differ per platform. The file must be reproduced exactly from salt and plaintext and must open with the entropy; it holds no session (spec 20).
